name: Pallu
overview: The Scriptures identify Pallu, also spelled Phallu, as one of the sons of Reuben, Israel's firstborn. He is consistently listed alongside his brothers Hanoch, Hezron, and Carmi as a patriarchal figure from whom distinct family lines, such as the Palluites, descended. These genealogical records in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, and 1 Chronicles emphasize God's providential establishment of tribal families within Israel, underscoring the faithfulness of God's covenant through the generations.
